label: General Medicine
description: General internal medicine cases that do not clearly fit a single organ-system specialty, covering common symptoms, lab abnormalities, comorbidities, and medication history. Used as the default when a case doesn't clearly match a more specific specialty.

fewShotExamples.input: 55-year-old man presents with fatigue, unintentional weight loss, and generalized lymphadenopathy of unclear etiology, pending further workup...
fewShotExamples.output: Fatigue and lymphadenopathy of unclear etiology

fewShotExamples.input: 68-year-old woman with poorly controlled type 2 diabetes and new-onset peripheral neuropathy...
40-year-old man with recurrent fevers, joint pain, and elevated inflammatory markers, evaluated for possible autoimmune disease...
fewShotExamples.output: Fever and arthralgia of unclear etiology, evaluated for autoimmune disease

eventExtraction.categoryIntro: Extract all clinically relevant and actionable events in the following categories:

categories.name: Symptoms and clinical findings
categories.block:
**Category 1 — Symptoms and clinical findings:**
"fatigue", "unintentional weight loss", "joint pain", "generalized lymphadenopathy"

postCategoryNotes: Focus on information that is directly relevant to differential diagnosis or clinical management. Avoid vague or redundant information like "patient appears well".

fewShotExample.caseNoteInput: 55-year-old man presents with a 3-month history of fatigue, unintentional 10-lb weight loss, and low-grade fevers. Exam reveals generalized lymphadenopathy. Labs show mild anemia and elevated CRP. Past medical history includes hypertension, managed with lisinopril.

guidanceNotes: **Focus on Actionable Events:** We are not trying to summarize the case but to find what information is relevant to decision-making. This helps filter noise and focus on clinically significant findings.
**Specific Search Terms:** Using exact clinical terms is essential for precision. Adding "differential diagnosis", "management" or "guidelines" helps to find relevant studies.
**Combinations:** Combining symptoms, lab findings, and comorbidities allows for refined searches that might be more relevant to the patient.
**Iteration:** If initial search results are not helpful, we can modify and refine the queries based on the available data.

articleScoring.evaluationGoal: evaluate full research articles related to internal medicine, especially those concerning differential diagnosis and management of complex or undifferentiated presentations, to identify potential advancements in diagnosis and treatment

domainFilterField.label: Clinical Focus
domainFilterField.description: Whether the article relates to a relevant internal medicine condition or diagnostic approach

fields.label: Disease Match
fields.description: Set to true if the article's clinical focus matches the patient's condition. Articles that cover the exact condition in question receive significant points.

fields.label: Drugs Tested
fields.description: Whether any drugs or interventions are mentioned as tested

fields.label: Treatment Results
fields.description: Set to true if the article demonstrates positive treatment or diagnostic results

fields.label: Cell Studies
fields.description: Whether interventions were tested on cells in vitro

fields.label: Animal Model Studies
fields.description: Whether interventions were tested in animal models

fields.label: Case Report
fields.description: Whether the article presents a case report

fields.label: Series of Case Reports
fields.description: Whether the article presents multiple case reports

fields.label: Clinical Study
fields.description: Whether the article describes a clinical study

fields.label: Novelty
fields.description: If the paper describes a novel diagnostic approach or management strategy
